testdescription:
真实端到端 SMOKE：使用精确 prompt“请总结当前 SR 的风险与建议下一步动作。”，校验界面显示消息与 OPENCODE SERVER 接收消息一致，不重复、不遗漏、不乱序；同时该 smoke 应作为性能优化后的系统级护栏，保证流式渲染、状态收敛、summary 完成态与消息序列比较继续成立，而不是只验证最终页面出现了一段文本。

"RuntimeView": {
"coveredComponents": [
"test_site 页面",
"extension content script / 浮动 AI 入口",
"embedded side panel iframe",
"sidepanel App + useSidepanelController",
"reasoningTimeline / reasoningTimelineView",
"extension shared api SSE 客户端",
"python_adapter FastAPI",
"opencode serve",
"python_adapter/logs/invocations.jsonl",
"Playwright smoke driver"
],
"interactionFlow": [
"Playwright smoke driver 打开 test_site 页面并通过 content script 唤起 embedded side panel iframe",
"side panel 通过 shared api 向 python_adapter POST /api/runs 发起 run，并建立 /api/runs/{runId}/events 或 raw events SSE 连接",
"python_adapter 创建或复用 opencode session，转发 prompt 到 opencode serve，并持续代理上游流式事件",
"sidepanel controller 接收 adapter 事件，投影为 transcriptReadModel，再由 reasoningTimelineView 渲染主舞台消息",
"smoke 脚本同时读取 python_adapter/logs/invocations.jsonl、extension state、comparison artifact 和最终可见 transcript，校验最终可见 assistant 消息与 canonical state 收敛一致，并保留 in-progress / completed checkpoint 以发现性能优化引入的回归"
]}
